subject.title: fix(deepinfra): use OpenAI video end point and tag DeepSeek thinking format

question: What upgrade contract should OpenClaw provide for existing DeepInfra installations that configure `nativeBaseUrl` for the native inference API?
rationale: The PR cannot safely choose whether a shipped provider setting remains functional, is migrated, or becomes intentionally breaking without maintainer ownership of the compatibility policy.

options.title: Preserve native routing
options.body: Keep the existing native request implementation when `nativeBaseUrl` is configured and use the new OpenAI videos route for default or `baseUrl` configurations.

options.title: Migrate the setting
options.body: Add a plugin-owned doctor migration that converts compatible legacy settings and reports custom native endpoints that cannot be translated safely.

options.title: Accept a breaking change
options.body: Remove the legacy behavior with explicit release documentation and require affected operators to reconfigure a compatible `baseUrl`.

recommendation.title: Preserve native routing
recommendation.body: Keep the existing native request implementation when `nativeBaseUrl` is configured and use the new OpenAI videos route for default or `baseUrl` configurations.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice governs a shipped provider configuration and upgrade contract rather than a purely mechanical implementation detail.
